tasks.question: [maintenance/brain] Title collisions: distinct items share one note name and overwrite each other (10)
tasks.fix: De-duplicate or suffix colliding titles so each item is its own note.
tasks.resolution: Real collision, not a false alarm (unlike the empty-body task): 3 of the 4 flagged name-pairs (Ponytail, Graphify, Higgsfield) were the SAME real tool mined twice by two independent pipelines (bulk_analyze vs mine_feeds/gemini-video) that only dedupe within their own call, not against each others writes -- a real ingestion race, now flagged separately for a future fire to harden. Fixed the 3 true dupes by marking the weaker record duplicate_of the richer one (kept, not deleted -- several data files key off tool:<slug> and a full consumer audit was out of scope this fire) and folding its unique videos/links into the survivor. The 4th pair (Headroom) turned out to be TWO DIFFERENT tools from different GitHub orgs (headroomlabs-ai vs chopratejas) that just share a generic name -- disambiguated the display name instead of merging so nothing gets wrongly conflated. maintenance_check/build_graph/build_brain now skip duplicate_of records so this specific collision cannot recur; verified health score 50->56, 0 title-collisions in the fresh report, brain_graph.json regenerated clean.

tasks.resolution: away fire 119: root-caused why data/review_findings.json was stuck at 2026-06-20 despite ~9 weeks of 'successful' Wed/Sat review.yml runs since. Two stacked bugs. (1) FIXED this fire: 'Plan this run' computed now=datetime.now() AFTER the fetch-depth:0 checkout (which can take 1-2+ min), so a run triggered near 23:59 UTC could read a weekday that had already rolled past midnight — weekly=False, the mandatory pass silently no-op'd, job still reported 'success' since skipped steps don't fail a job. Verified against run 31058169311 (2026-08-05 23:58:44 UTC trigger, Wed; checkout alone ate ~75s; plan step read 00:00:03 UTC Aug 6 = Thursday; skipped). Fix: capture the trigger epoch in a step BEFORE checkout, pass it into the plan step, compute weekday from that instead of a fresh now(). Verified: extracted the plan script and ran it standalone with TRIGGER_EPOCH=2026-08-05T23:58:44Z -> run=true/mode=weekly (was false under the old now()-after-checkout path in the real run). (2) STILL OPEN, not fixed this fire: even on days the day-check DOES pass (e.g. run 30724272208, 2026-08-01, a real Saturday firing), the Claude Code action step itself fails near-instantly (`is_error:true`, duration_ms 2317, num_turns 1, total_cost_usd 0) before writing anything to review_findings.json. Full SDK output is hidden ('for security') so the actual error text isn't visible from the job log alone -- next fire should try workflow_dispatch with show_full_output:true (or a scoped debug run) to see the real error (token/quota/permission?) rather than guessing.
